description.text: Teaching Objectives This program offers you an unique opportunity not only to learn but to experience the dynamic cultural and economic context of China and its relationship with the rest of the world. Students will gain an advanced understanding of China’s economic and business environment，acquire the linguistic and intercultural skills necessary to operate effectively in China，and obtain real working experience through internship opportunities. Core Courses International Business Microeconomic Theory Macroeconomic Theory Social Science Research Methods Chinese Culture Studies Marketing in China China Business Laws China Business Environment China Foreign Relations China and International Organizations Elementary Chinese Business Chinese Duration 2 years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Master Degree of Chinese Business and International Relations by Beijing Foreign Studies University

duration.text: The Chinese Business and International Relations at Beijing Foreign Studies University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6236 USD/per year ￥ 44900 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Copy of photo page of passport 2. One recent passport photo 3. Custody Release Form 4. Proof of English Proficiency: TOEFL, IELTS or TOEIC 5. Transcripts/Mark Sheets 6. Diploma or Degree Certificate 7. Personal Statement 8. Letter(s) of recommendation (master program applicants) 9. Resume (master program applicants)

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be non-Chinese in good health. 2. Applicants must be under the age of 18. 3. Completed undergraduate degree in a relevant field from a recognized tertiary institution. 4. Proficiency in English language, must have TOEFL (IBT)88/ IELTS 6.5/TOEIC 800 scores or higher
